text:
Ana M: Hey team — Aurora Health just finished their post-POC writeup. They offered a short quote and a 15-min video clip. Can we lock approvals and pick a webinar slot?
Jordan P: Nice. Do we have their exact quote?
Ana M: "Redwood helped us cut inference costs by 62% and reduced latency spikes" — they gave permission to edit for clarity.
Maria (Product): We should confirm the exact edit boundary with legal first.
Linda (Legal): Quick heads-up — ok to edit for clarity but not to add numbers not in the customer's confirmation. Need the signed quote release form. I've put a draft in /drive/marketing/releases/aurora_release_v1.docx :link:
Sam E: Ping on whether we need the demo clip trimmed. I can do a 60s clip with timestamps if they approve.
Ana M: They also sent a brief recording of their CTO (14:12). I'll upload the raw shortly.
content-bot: Uploaded file aurora-cto-2026-03-10-1412.mp4 (4.2MB)
Jordan P: Suggested timeline: legal signoff by Tue, asset prep Wed, webinar slot Thurs/next week depending on availability.
Linda (Legal): I can sign the release once they've initialed section 3 (permission to publish). Please @Ana M ask the contact to initial and return.
Maria (Product): We'll need a short 1-slide benchmark summary for the webinar showing latency/cost delta. Sam can pull metrics.
Sam E: I'll pull the bench results — need the baseline model and the variant used. @Ana M can you paste model/commit?
Ana M: Baseline: open-llm/v1.2 baseline config; Redwood served model: rwinf-optimized/gpt-medium-q4  — commit cf1a2b.
Sam E: Got it. I'll assemble a 1-slider with the CI plots.
Jordan P: For messaging, let's A/B test the headline: A) "Aurora reduces inference TCO 60%" B) "Aurora accelerates customer-facing ML features with Redwood" — prefer A for benchmarks.
Ana M: Customer prefers a numbers-led headline if it's accurate.
Linda (Legal): Once we have the signed release, legal approves both headline variants. No industry or competitor comparisons allowed.
Jordan P: Can we get a firm webinar date? Proposed: Thu Mar 25 11am PT or Tue Mar 30 9am PT.
Ana M: I'll check with their team now.
(A short pause)
Ana M: They confirmed Tue Mar 30 9am PT works.
Jordan P: Great. I'll create the registration landing page. Sam, give me the 1-slide by EOD Fri.
Sam E: Will do.
Maria (Product): Who's drafting the case writeup?
Ana M: I'll draft the first pass and share for edits. Expect by Mon.
Linda (Legal): Reminder: include the signed release as an appendix in the PR package.
Ana M: Noted. Will follow up after I get initialed doc.
Jordan P: Perfect — thanks everyone. :party-parrot:
